capability: Agents redesign freely, but locked numbers hold
title: Some numbers get a pin.

hook.picture: Close on the whale holding a baton-shaped line. A pod returns a smoother redesign and the whale's fin sinks under its weight. A hand pod turns copper ✕.
hook.words: I only asked for a nicer grip.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I asked for a nicer grip. It came back twice as heavy.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: product designer reviewing an AI redesign

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: three redesigns in a row. The first quietly moves the weight (2 beats). It repeats, faster each time.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Nobody said which numbers must stay.

stakes.body: Each AI redesign drifts a safety or comfort number, and someone has to catch it by hand, every time.

solution_hint: Lock the numbers that must not move.

metaphor.body: Three pins hold the baton line at its weight, light and size. The pod can bend the shape however it likes between them, and any tug on a pin is measured and snapped back. Copper alarm.

steps.picture: Three hollow pins drop onto the baton line and fill: weight, laser, size. Strip: Lock · Change · Check.
steps.words: Lock the numbers that must not move.
steps.sound: Bamboo note, in tune, per pin

steps.picture: The pod reshapes the grip freely. The line bends wildly between the pins, and every pin holds.
steps.words: Change the shape. The pins stay put.

steps.picture: Push-in: a redesign tugs the weight pin. It glows copper, a ring measures it, and the pin snaps home.
steps.sound: Note bends, then snaps into tune

steps.picture: The three pins glow together, labelled.
steps.words: The pins together are the spec.

steps.picture: A mode chip flips to DRIVE. The laser pin turns solid: off.

real_case.claim: aor-ki locks envelope parameters for any agent using its SKILL.md: feel=light 64–72 g, feel=planted 100–110 g, laser Class 2 or lower, laser off in DRIVE mode.

honest_limit.picture: A redesign sits inside every pin, but its grip edge is sharp. All pins glow fine. The hand pod winces ✕.
honest_limit.words: Inside every limit. Still feels wrong.

not_this.body: Locked numbers do not make it feel right.

ending_pattern.body: The same hand-over as act 1. This time the fin stays level, because the weight pin never moved through the redesign.
ending_pattern.callback: Act 1's fin sinking under the weight now stays level, with the pin unmoved.

end_belief.body: Name the numbers no redesign may move.

score_self.reason: The "came back twice as heavy" pain is concrete and funny, and pins map perfectly. The numbers come from a real spec. It is a hardware story in a memory and harness cluster, so it reads more like a guardrails film.
